## Episode Thesis

The episode features Henrik von Sydow, a global strategist at DNB Carnegie, discussing the Xi Jinping–Donald Trump summit in Washington. The main outcomes were a two-month extension of the trade truce to 10 January and an AI-safety hotline between the two governments. He expects 'more competition than cooperation': two separate AI ecosystems developing, which means global investors need exposure to both the US and China, for example through Hong Kong listings. He sees stable US–China relations with no major breakthroughs but warns of sector-level volatility, especially in semiconductors, tied to Nvidia chip exports and Taiwan. He also covers Iran, where inflation of 60–70% is putting economic pressure on the regime and could push it towards negotiations.
